title: [Download] 3D Printing Quick Reference Guides
summary: Easily compare process specifications, tolerances, materials, and finishes with our quick reference guides for the various 3D printing processes we offer!
body_markdown:
Looking for the best[3D printing process](https://www.xometry.com/capabilities/3d-printing-service/) for your project? Xometry’s **Quick Reference Guides** provide essential details on materials, build tolerances, surface finishes, and more—helping you make informed decisions for your prototypes and production parts.


Each guide covers:


- Available materials


- Build tolerances & resolutions


- Maximum part sizes


- Minimum feature sizes


- Surface finish options


## Get the Guides


Each guide listed below provides top-level technical details you need to know to confidently bring your designs to life. Click on the process name to download its corresponding reference sheet:


**Thermoplastic 3D Printing:**


- **📥[SLS (Selective Laser Sintering) Quick Reference Guide](https://xometry-marketing.cdn.prismic.io/xometry-marketing/Z-GdWndAxsiBv1Wo_3DPSLSQuickRefGuide.pdf)** – Durable, high-performance nylon parts
- **📥[MJF (Multi Jet Fusion) Quick Reference Guide](https://xometry-marketing.cdn.prismic.io/xometry-marketing/Z-GdXndAxsiBv1Ws_3DPMJFQuickRefGuide.pdf)** – Tough thermoplastics with smooth finishes
- **📥[FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling) Quick Reference Guide](https://xometry-marketing.cdn.prismic.io/xometry-marketing/Z-GdXXdAxsiBv1Wr_3DPFDMQuickRefGuide.pdf)** – Real thermoplastics for strong, lightweight parts


**Resin 3D Printing:**


- **📥[SLA (Stereolithography) Quick Reference Guide](https://xometry-marketing.cdn.prismic.io/xometry-marketing/aCIj-CdWJ-7kR88S_3DPSLAQuickRefGuide.pdf)** – Exceptional surface quality for intricate designs
- **📥[PolyJet Quick Reference Guide](https://xometry-marketing.cdn.prismic.io/xometry-marketing/Z-GdXHdAxsiBv1Wq_3DPPolyJetQuickRefGuide.pdf)** – Full-color, multi-material prototypes
- **📥[Carbon DLS Quick Reference Guide](https://xometry-marketing.cdn.prismic.io/xometry-marketing/aeEE6J1ZCF7ETQj2_Carbon-DLS_Quick-Reference-Guide.pdf)** – High-resolution, durable photopolymer parts


**Metal 3D Printing:**


- **📥[DMLS (Direct Metal Laser Sintering) Quick Reference Guide](https://xometry-marketing.cdn.prismic.io/xometry-marketing/Z-GdWXdAxsiBv1Wn_3DPDMLSQuickRefGuide.pdf)** – Fully dense metal printing
- **📥[Metal Binder Jetting Quick Reference Guide](https://xometry-marketing.cdn.prismic.io/xometry-marketing/Z-GdX3dAxsiBv1Wt_3DPMBJRefGuide.pdf)** – Cost-effective metal prototyping
